profile.headline: Software Engineer | Founder | Ex-Google
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at Google Cloud, where I worked on large-scale on-boarding, provisioning, compliance, and reliability initiatives. 

Since leaving Google, I've been building software products independently, taking projects from product strategy and architecture through development, testing, and deployment while managing the technical side of an early-stage business. 

I enjoy working across the stack, but especially gravitate toward back-end systems, cloud infrastructure, and solving complex engineering problems. I'm particularly interested in building products from the ground up, turning ambiguous ideas into practical systems, and working with small teams where engineers can have meaningful ownership.

If you would like to know more about me or any of my projects, please feel free to reach out to me through e-mail or on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a full-stack Pokemon TCG collection platform using TypeScript, React, Redux, Bun, Elysia, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Docker, building a REST API and responsive web application around a relational data model.

- Built authenticated collection management functionality including card and set browsing, complex filtering, collection and list tracking, user settings, and saved filter presets, with authorization and unit test coverage across the application.

- Developed integrations and automation for a streaming business, connecting Discord, Twitch, OBS, and VTube Studio to support community interactions and recurring content management workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained production services in Java and Go supporting GCP organization onboarding and provisioning, using Kubernetes-based infrastructure, Cloud Spanner databases, gRPC APIs, GCP IAM, and other internal tools.

- Implemented GCP-wide infrastructure compliance initiatives across multiple services, independently translating organization-level requirements into technical solutions for alerting, multi-party approval, regression prevention, and new audit-logging services while coordinating cross-team dependencies.

- Developed interactive user-facing RPC workflows supporting GDPR and data-residency requirements for European GCP resellers, guiding resellers and internal teams through service configuration and RPC execution inside and outside the default GCP environment.

- Implemented production service changes spanning RPC behavior, protobuf definitions, service configuration, and IAM policies, along with unit, functional, and end-to-end tests to validate changes.

- Supported production reliability through weekly on-call rotations for critical GCP onboarding services, resolving cross-team API requests, KTLO work, and production issues while troubleshooting service failures against a 99.9995% SLO and 30-minute response target.

positions.title: Software Engineer Assistant
positions.description:
- Conducted mock technical interviews covering systems design, data structures & algorithms, and technical fundamentals.

- Debugged student projects and provided technical support across coding challenges and curriculum modules.

projects.title: 2D Tile Map Editor
projects.description: Built a browser based tile map editor for 2D game level design, replacing individual tile placement with a brush-based workflow inspired by digital art tools. Implemented layer scaling, offsetting, and parallax directly in the editor to provide real time visualization of how levels would appear in game. Built the application using JavaScript, Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO.

projects.title: JS Platforming Game Demo & Custome Engine
projects.description: Developed a 2D platform game with a custom built game engine featuring a Trigger/Condition/Action system, finite-state-machine AI, and broad/narrow phase collision detection and culling. Built the game and engine using JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and PixiJS, with gameplay systems supporting exploration, collectibles, abilities, and unlockable characters.
